The '''spidercat''' was a [[Hair/Legends|fur]]-covered [[Insect/Legends|insect]] that lived on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It had characteristics of both [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] and [[Cat/Legends|cats]] and had a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] bite. The creature was [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] by Tasariq's [[Tasari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for use as temple guardians when they were worshipping the local [[tasar crystal]]s in the wake of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] devastation by a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] bombardment.

==Biology and appearance==
The spidercat was a type of two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Hair/Legends|fur]]-covered [[Insect/Legends|insect]] that lived on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It had the appearance of a cross between a [[Spider/Legends|spider]] and a [[Cat/Legends|cat]]: it had eight long, segmented [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that were equipped with barbed [[Claw/Legends|claws]], but its head also had a pair of [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a [[Nose/Legends|nose]], whiskers, and a [[Tooth/Legends|toothed]] [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The latter could deliver a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] bite that could induce paralysis between one and six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] long.<ref name="Journal15" />

==History==
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], after Tasariq was devastated by an intense [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] bombardment, the society of the planet's native [[Tasari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] adopted a low [[Technology level|level of technology]] and began worshipping their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] newly formed [[tasar crystal]]s. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Tasari [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] spidercats for use as guardians at temples dedicated to the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the creatures could still be encountered on Tasariq, with those inhabiting the areas in the vicinity of the by-then-forgotten temples being particularly ferocious.<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ15.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Spidercats were introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15.]]
The spidercat was introduced in "[[Tasariq: The Crystal Planet]]," a [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tom Moldvay]] and [[Steve Miller]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. In the article, the creature was illustrated by [[Jeff Menges]].<ref name="Journal15" />

"Tasariq: The Crystal Planet" also includes a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure idea in which the player characters travel the distance of 2,300 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] between the planet Tasariq's [[Tasariq City]] and the [[Roaring Crater]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement. The article suggests that, on each [[Local day/Legends|day]] of that journey across Tasariq's surface, the characters have a one-in-eighteen chance of encountering the planet's wildlife, which the gamemaster player can decide (or choose at random) to be either one to three spidercats, [[sting-snake]]s, or [[Tunnel worm (Tasariq)|tunnel worms]].<ref name="Journal15" />
